about: Every program deployed on the Ferrata LEZ test network (the network named below; its /programs.json): where its source is, how it is rebuilt, and the image id and binary sha256 the rebuild must give. scripts/reproduce/deployed.sh rebuilds them; scripts/reproduce/check_network.py compares the network's /programs.json and each program's loader header on chain with this file. Served to the browser as /apps/registry.json (deploy/testnet/web/trust/apps/registry.json is this file's copy; test_trust.py holds them equal).
toolchain: RISC Zero 3.0.5 (risc0-build =3.0.5), guest Rust 1.91.1 in RISC0_HOME=risc0-home-lez, host Rust 1.93.0, through scripts/guest-rustc (path-independent guest builds); the image of scripts/reproduce/Dockerfile

sources.build: cd lez && cargo build -p methods -p methods-statements -p methods-rebate --locked

sources.where: public main: the messages programs' commit (v1's guest and wire crate as deployed)
deployed v1: source not in public history (v2's is in lez/guests/names and lez/names-wire; the two differ only in lez/names-wire/src/lib.rs)
sources.select: lez/scripts/lez-select.sh v0.4.0-rc3, then every lez/ manifest's upstream/lez-v0.4.0-rc1 path set to rc3 (names/e2e/box.sh copy_tree)

programs.name: ferrata_attestation
programs.title: Attestation program
programs.what: Verifies Ethereum consensus (sync committee light client) and proves facts about Ethereum state on LEZ.

programs.name: ferrata_bridge_b1
programs.title: Bridge program (milestone B1)
programs.what: The LEZ side of the private ERC-20/ETH bridge: claims of deposits, burns for release.

programs.name: ferrata_consumer
programs.title: Reference consumer
programs.what: Example program that reads an attested fact and acts on it.

programs.name: ferrata_holdings
programs.title: Holdings (worked example)
programs.what: Second consumer: gates an action on an attested token holding.

programs.name: ferrata_statements
programs.title: Recorded statements
programs.what: Keeps attested statements on chain for later readers.

programs.name: ferrata_rebate
programs.title: Operator rebate
programs.what: Pays back the operator who keeps the light client current.

programs.name: ferrata_msg
programs.title: Encrypted messages
programs.what: Wallet-to-wallet encrypted inbox (the wallet's Messages tab).

programs.name: ferrata_names
programs.title: Names
programs.what: Human-readable names for LEZ accounts, commit-reveal registration.
